arxiv-2212-10700.title: Stuffle regularized multiple Eisenstein series revisited
arxiv-2212-10700.creator: Henrik Bachmann
arxiv-2212-10700.description: Abstract . Multiple Eisenstein series are holomorphic functions in the complex upper-half plane, which can be seen as a crossbreed between multiple zeta values and classical Eisenstein series. They were originally defined by Gangl-Kaneko-Zagier in 2006, and since then, many variants and regularizations of them have been studied.

arxiv-2402-02085.title: Detecting AI-Generated Video via Frame Consistency
arxiv-2402-02085.creator: Long Ma, Zhiyuan Yan, Qinglang Guo, Yong Liao, Haiyang Yu, Pengyuan Zhou
arxiv-2402-02085.description: Abstract The increasing realism of AI-generated videos has raised potential security concerns, making it difficult for humans to distinguish them from the naked eye. Despite these concerns, limited research has been dedicated to detecting such videos effectively. To this end, we propose an open-source AI-generated video detection dataset .

arxiv-2407-01180.title: Deploying AI-Based Applications with Serverless Computing in 6G Networks: An Experimental Study
arxiv-2407-01180.creator: Marc Michalke, Chukwuemeka Muonagor and Admela Jukan
arxiv-2407-01180.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Marc Michalke, Chukwuemeka Muonagor and Admela Jukan. Future 6G networks are expected to heavily utilize machine learning capabilities in a wide variety of applications with features and benefits for both, the end user and the provider. While the options for utilizing these technologies are almost endless, from the perspective of network architecture and standardized service, the deployment decisions on where to execute the AI-tasks are critical, especially when considering the dynamic and heterogeneous nature of processing and connectivity capability of 6G networks.

arxiv-2502-03559.title: Comprehensive Layer-wise Analysis of SSL Models for Audio Deepfake Detection
arxiv-2502-03559.creator: Yassine El Kheir, Youness Samih, Suraj Maharjan, Tim Polzehl, Sebastian Möller
arxiv-2502-03559.description: Abstract This paper conducts a comprehensive layer-wise analysis of self-supervised learning (SSL) models for audio deepfake detection across diverse contexts, including multilingual datasets (English, Chinese, Spanish), partial, song, and scene-based deepfake scenarios. By systematically evaluating the contributions of different transformer layers, we uncover critical insights into model behavior and performance.

pmc-10641318.title: A Case Series of DuraMatrix-Onlay® Plus in Cranial Surgery Is Associated With a Low Complication Profile
pmc-10641318.creator: Mahlet Mekonnen, Gabrielle Hovis, Natalie Mahgerefteh, Anubhav Chandla, Yelena Malkhasyan, Ashley B. Zhang, Isaac Yang
pmc-10641318.description: BackgroundDuraMatrix-Onlay® Plus is a collagen dura membrane derived from purified bovine Achilles tendon. The matrix provides a scaffold for collagen synthesis and is intended to be used as an onlay without the need for dural sutures. The study aims to describe our experience with 33 consecutive patients who underwent a duraplasty procedure using the novel DuraMatrix-Onlay® Plus collagen dura membrane.

pmc-11312819.title: Oculomotor Patterns in Children with Poor Reading Abilities Measured Using the Development Eye Movement Test
pmc-11312819.creator: Danjela Ibrahimi, Marcos Aviles, Juvenal Rodríguez-Reséndiz
pmc-11312819.description: Objectives: The main purpose of this work was to clinically assess the oculomotricity of one hundred Mexican children with poor reading skills but without any specific learning disorder. Methods: The D.E.M. psychometric test was used. Sex and age analyses of the ratio, type, horizontal and vertical performance, and errors were carried out.

pmc-11424491.title: Probing plant signal processing optogenetically by two channelrhodopsins
pmc-11424491.creator: Meiqi Ding, Yang Zhou, Dirk Becker, Shang Yang, Markus Krischke, Sönke Scherzer, Jing Yu-Strzelczyk, Martin J. Mueller, Rainer Hedrich, Georg Nagel, Shiqiang Gao, Kai R. Konrad
pmc-11424491.description: Early plant responses to different stress situations often encompass cytosolic Ca2+ increases, plasma membrane depolarization and the generation of reactive oxygen species1–3. However, the mechanisms by which these signalling elements are translated into defined physiological outcomes are poorly understood. Here, to study the basis for encoding of specificity in plant signal processing, we used light-gated ion channels (channelrhodopsins).

pmc-11426163.title: The effects of SNAP emergency allotments on state-level SNAP benefits and enrollment during the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-11426163.creator: David R Steffen, David D Kim
pmc-11426163.description: During the COVID-19 pandemic, all US states provided emergency allotments (EA) to enrollees of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) to alleviate rising food insecurity. However, 18 states opted out of the SNAP-EA program before its official expiration in February 2023.

pmc-12563546.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) causes a variety of health problems including renal dysfunction and cardiovascular disease. pmc-13094560.description: BackgroundChronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is the most common respiratory disease among middle-aged and older adults worldwide, and its etiology remains incompletely understood. pmc-13195740.title: 白头翁皂苷B4通过调控MAPK和Keap1/Nrf2信号通路介导的上皮-间充质转化抑制非小细胞肺癌转移
pmc-13195740.creator: Qian SU, Lianting LIAO, Lina LIU, Linyu XIAO, Yufang SHEN, Shilin YANG, Renyikun YUAN, Hongwei GAO, 方 余, 洁 沈
pmc-13195740.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的探讨白头翁皂苷B4（AB4）对非小细胞肺癌转移的影响及作用机制。方法体外实验采用MTT法检测AB4对人非小细胞肺癌细胞A549和H1975活性的影响；细胞划痕和Transwell实验检测AB4对转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）诱导的A549和H1975细胞迁移及侵袭能力的影响；蛋白质印迹法及免疫荧光法检测上皮-间充质转化（EMT）、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）和氧化应激信号通路相关蛋白的表达。体内实验通过尾静脉注射B16-F10细胞建立C57BL/6J小鼠皮肤黑色素瘤肺转移模型，用AB4（20、40 mg/kg）干预后检测模型鼠血常规指标、苏木精-伊红染色观察肺组织病理变化、蛋白质印迹法检测肺组织EMT、MAPK和氧化应激信号通路相关蛋白表达。结果在体外实验中，AB4（5、10、20 μmol/L）无细胞毒性，但其可抑制TGF-β1诱导的A549和H1975细胞迁移及侵袭，下调EMT信号通路中神经钙黏素、波形蛋白、Slug和Snail表达，上调上皮钙黏素表达，也可下调氧化应激信号通路中Keap1表达，上调Nrf2表达，还能够降低MAPK信号通路中磷酸化JNK、磷酸化ERK、磷酸化p38表达水平。在体内实验中，AB4可减少肺转移模型鼠体重下降，抑制黑色素瘤肺转移，机制可能与抑制模型鼠肺组织中EMT、氧化应激和MAPK信号通路有关。结论AB4通过调控MAPK信号通路和Keap1/Nrf2氧化应激介导的EMT，抑制肿瘤转移。Keywords: 非小细胞肺癌, 肿瘤转移, 白头翁皂苷B4, 上皮-间充质转化, 丝裂原活化蛋白激酶, 氧化应激, 小鼠 肺癌是一种起源于支气管黏膜或肺泡上皮的恶性肿瘤，可分为非小细胞肺癌和小细胞肺癌两大类，其中80%~85%为非小细胞肺癌［1-2］，其致死率居各类癌症的首位［3］。由于肺癌早期症状大多不明显（转移亚临床阶段），多数患者临床确诊时属于晚期（已发生转移），超过90%的肺癌患者主要死于肿瘤转移［4-5］。肿瘤转移是指恶性肿瘤细胞从原发部位通过血液循环及淋巴系统向远端器官或组织迁移，并在靶部位定植和增殖，最终形成继发性肿瘤的生物学过程［6］。EMT是调控肿瘤转移的关键过程。肿瘤细胞通过启动EMT，失去上皮细胞原有的极性和细胞间粘附力，并获得间充质细胞的迁移和侵袭能力。该过程与Snail家族锌指转录因子和TGF-β1信号通路等密切相关［7］。TGF-β1通过启动MAPK信号级联反应，下调上皮钙黏素表达，诱导MMP活性增强，从而促进细胞迁移［7］。Nrf2作为氧化应激反应的关键调控蛋白，其与MAPK信号通路相互作用共同调控EMT，在肿瘤转移和侵袭过程中发挥至关重要的作用。 肺癌的临床治疗主要依赖手术、放疗、化疗、靶向及免疫治疗［8］，但化疗毒性高、靶向治疗耐药频发、免疫治疗应答率有限，且上述治疗方法对转移灶疗效差。白头翁（Radix Pulsatillae）系毛茛科白头翁属植物，药用部位为其干燥根，是安徽滁州的道地药材。白头翁有清热解毒、凉血止痢和燥湿杀虫等功效［9］。白头翁皂苷是从白头翁中提取出的一类主要成分，具有多种生物活性，其主要活性单体AB4具有抗肿瘤、抗炎、抗病毒、镇痛、免疫调节和肾损伤保护等药理作用［10-13］。研究发现，经AB4干预后胃癌细胞的迁移及侵袭能力明显减弱，同时伴随MMP-2、MMP-9表达水平下降，提示AB4可能通过下调MMP-2、MMP-9表达抑制胃癌细胞迁移及侵袭［14］。本研究在体外实验中通过TGF-β1诱导建立非小细胞肺癌细胞EMT模型，评估AB4对非小细胞肺癌细胞迁移和侵袭的影响，并从分子层面探究AB4如何通过调控氧化应激及MAPK信号通路来抑制EMT过程；在体内实验中采用尾静脉注射B16-F10小鼠皮肤黑色素瘤细胞构建肺转移模型，进一步在动物水平验证AB4对肿瘤转移及EMT相关作用通路的干预作用，从而阐明其抑制肿瘤转移的潜在机制。 pmc-13232724.title: Metabolic reprogramming is critical to microglial activation in Huntington’s disease
pmc-13232724.creator: Abhishek Jauhari, Adam C Monek, Olena S Abakumova, Tanisha Singh, Sukhman Singh, Xiaomin Wang, Carley S Clise, Diane L Carlisle, Robert M Friedlander
pmc-13232724.description: Huntington’s disease (HD) is a fatal neurodegenerative disease caused by an expanded polyglutamine (CAG) repeat in the N-terminal of the huntingtin protein (HTT). Microglial activation and elevated proinflammatory cytokines are observed in HD brains, but the mechanisms regulating neuroinflammation and microglial activation are poorly understood. Metformin-mediated neuroprotection has been demonstrated in experimental models of neurodegeneration, including HD.

pmc-13243579.creator: Zhenshuan Zhao, Xiaoguang Yu, Feng Zhao, Jun Li
pmc-13243579.description: To elucidate the protective mechanism of SHP2 in OA by targeting the BRD4/autophagy/apoptosis axis, focusing on its role in alleviating IL-1β-induced cartilage degradation and mitochondrial dysfunction. The OA- related mRNA dataset GSE82107 was first bioinformatically analyzed to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs) and enrichment pathways using R language packages (limma, ggplot2) and the DAVID platform.
